name: match-statement-static-patterns-test-4828836871/static-match-patterns-unreachable-e.bal
spec_references: Statements: [Match statement] — Currently only supports [const-pattern] and [wildcard-match-pattern]
reason: The negative case asserts unreachable-pattern diagnostics for structured list and mapping match patterns and var binding patterns. These essential patterns exceed the explicit const-pattern/wildcard-match-pattern restriction, so the whole case requires unsupported features even though some constant and wildcard reachability checks are in scope.
unsupported_constructs: List match patterns such as ["A", 15] and []
Mapping match patterns such as {a: 200, b: "A"} and {}
Binding match patterns such as var [], var {}, var {a} and var s
test_design_notes: The asserted behavior is compile-time rejection of unreachable patterns and unreachable code; the unsupported structured and binding pattern overlap checks are central assertions.
